status: approved 2026-11-04 (D1-D3 as recommended); in execution. D4 and D5 are owner data, open.
goal: Enable inventory management in POS: see stock, see what moved it, correct it, and ask an agent about it.
business_objective: The owner and staff of GMO Lavandería know what is on the shelf and what is running out, using the ledger that already posts every sale and purchase, instead of a number nobody can see.
affected_products: Laundry (companyId 1 is the only company with tracked products)

existing.verified: Live DB and repos read on 2026-11-04.
database: inventoryStock, inventoryMovements (ledger; 17 stock rows, 47 movements: 27 sale, 17 purchase, 2 unit_change, 1 sale_reversal)
sp_inventory_post — the one correct write path (ledger row + balance, HOLDLOCK)
trg_incomeDetails_inventory, trg_incomeDetails_consumption, trg_expenseDetails_inventory — post sales and purchases automatically
productConsumptions (19 rules; Factory-generated 2026-10-26, finished by hand in 2026-10-27c) + sp_productConsumptions, _all, _one
products.trackInventory (19 products, all companyId 1), stockUnit, netContent
fn_ruleQuantity, fn_recipeAvailable — no SP calls fn_recipeAvailable, so availability reaches nobody
unusable_as_is: sp_inventory_list and sp_inventory_adjust have no callers and do not fit: they take @companyId / @pjson, while databases.py SafeCursor needs the single-parameter EXEC ... @pjsonfile = %s shape. sp_inventory_adjust also writes the balance itself instead of calling sp_inventory_post. Leave them in place; do not build on them.
frontend: ProductWizard and ProductsManagementPage show stockQuantity on a product; nothing shows the ledger
data_gaps: minStockQty is 0 on every stock row, so nothing can be 'low' until thresholds are set
2 of 19 tracked products have no stock row

decisions_required.question: How does a ledger + read model fit a generator built for one CRUD table?
decisions_required.recommendation: PRD module `inventoryMovement` (table inventoryMovements matches the sp_{plural} naming; `inventoryStock` does not pluralize to its table). Stock list and min-stock setting are extra actions on the same SP. No update or delete: the ledger is append-only.
decisions_required.alternative: Hand-write the SP as a documented exception and generate only backend + frontend.

decisions_required.question: Who may adjust stock?
decisions_required.recommendation: Admin and Manager adjust and set minimums; Cashier reads only.

decisions_required.question: Is the agent generated by the Factory or written by hand this first time?
decisions_required.recommendation: Generate it (F3). Writing it by hand is faster but counts as unplanned human implementation and leaves the Delivery Rate unproven for that repo.

decisions_required.question: When is the opening physical count (inventory-portions-design.md §10.5)?
decisions_required.recommendation: Do it the week T3 is deployed, using the new adjustment screen. Stock is not trustworthy before it.

decisions_required.question: Which minimum stock per product? Owner data, not code; needed only for low-stock answers to be meaningful.
decisions_required.recommendation: Set after T3, on the products that run out most.

risks: The generator emits update/delete for an append-only ledger. Mitigation: T0 hints + a review check that nothing writes inventoryStock directly.
Adjustments race with sale triggers. Mitigation: only sp_inventory_post writes, which holds the lock.
Tenant leakage. Mitigation: companyId from the session, never from the agent (_RESERVED_KEYS already rejects it).
Module naming: a page generated as InventoryMovement while the user-facing feature is Inventario. Mitigation: route and labels set explicitly in the PRD; check at T0.
Uncommitted work in all three product repos, including backend main.py, which T2 patches. Mitigation: commit or park it before the run.
Live DB is shared. knowledge_sync and schema reads are read-only; the T1 migration is run by the owner after checking the [appEnv] banner.
First real Gemini run of the MVVM frontend: it has only been proven by unit tests. Expect at least one RE-PLAN.
